narr: An area of heavy rain and thunderstorms moved over the same area of Pamlico County on the morning of July 15th to produce flash flooding near Merritt. The previous night a similar pattern produced flash flooding in Greenville.
ev: Water inundated Highway 55 in Merritt, making it impassable. Department of Transportation was on site.
lsr: WATER INUNDATING HIGHWAY 55 IN MERRITT. DOT ON SITE.
